title: Advanced Cell and Molecular Biology
topics: Protein folding & Correction of misfolded protein
Cell Junctions, cell adhesion and Extra cellular matrix
Tissue renewal and Stem cell engineering

handout.makeup_policy: Makeups for quizzes, seminar or assignment will not be granted in any condition. Make-ups for Tests will be granted only in case of severe medical urgency or hospitalization upon timely submission of valid proofs.
topics: Course Orientation, discussion on mode of conductance of various evaluation components, seminar topics
Cell cycle Overview, different phases, cell cycle control and regulatory components, control of cell division and cell growth, Cyclin Kinase inhibitors
Mechanism of cell death with special reference to apoptosis and necrosis, cascade of apoptosis implications
Mechanism of protein folding in E.coli and mammalian systems, Molecular chaperones, Protein trafficking across cell and export, Proteolysis

Mechanisms of signal transduction by cell surface receptor proteins (G proteins, enzyme coupled receptors), growth factors and their interaction with receptors in cell proliferation and its regulation, JAK – STAT, Wnt, Hedgehog, Notch, NF-κB pathways
Molecular basis of cancer, Cancer as micro-evolutionary process, cancer critical genes, molecular basis of cancer – cell behavior
Mechanism for the transport of RNA and Cargo proteins into and out of nucleus
Cadherins, cell – cell adhesions, tight junctions and gap junctions, Role of CAMs in cell attachment, Basal Lamina, integrins, Components of ECM, role of ECM in bi-directional signaling
Epidermis and its renewal by Stem cells, multipotent stem cells, stem cell engineering
